name: Raizo
source:
"I can't take my eyes off of you"

Type: Humanoid Beast
A hybrid of a monkey, tiger and snake.

Favorites: grass-flavored rice cake

One of the four who appeared in front of you when mononokes attacked the castle.
There is no one who can defeat him. Despite his scary appearance, he is kind to women and has a caring side.
Strong and reliable. You'd give yourself all to him...
